title: Effects of Sleep on Recall
---
# Abstract

We study the effect of sleep duration on short-term recall in 120 participants.[^1]

# Introduction

Prior work suggests a link between sleep and memory consolidation.

# Methods

Participants were randomised into two groups.

$$ r = \frac{\sum (x - \bar{x})(y - \bar{y})}{n s_x s_y} $$

# Results

Recall improved by 12% (p < 0.01).

# Discussion

The results are consistent with consolidation theory.

# References

1. Smith, J. (2020). Sleep and memory. *Journal of Cognition*, 4(2).

[^1]: Data available on request.

title: Widget CLI Manual
---
# Installation

Install with pip:

```bash
pip install widget
```

# Configuration

Create `widget.toml`:

```toml
[server]
port = 8080
```

:::warning
Never commit secrets to `widget.toml`.
:::

# Usage

1. Start the server
2. Open the dashboard
   1. Log in
   2. Select a project

```bash
widget serve --port 8080
```

# Troubleshooting

If the port is in use, choose another with `--port`.

title: Sleep Duration and Exam Performance in First-Year Students
---
# Abstract
We followed 312 first-year students for one semester and compared sleep diaries with exam results.
# Introduction
Short sleep is common among students, yet its link to assessed performance is debated.
# Methods
Participants kept a sleep diary for twelve weeks. Exam marks were obtained with consent.
# Results
Each additional hour of sleep was associated with a 2.1 point higher mark (95% CI 1.2 to 3.0).
# Discussion
The association held after adjusting for course and prior attainment.
# References
1. Walker M. Why We Sleep. Scribner; 2017.

# A Survey of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
## Abstract
We review 84 papers on retrieval-augmented generation published between 2020 and 2025.
## Literature Review
Early systems retrieved passages with sparse indexes; later work moved to dense retrievers.
## Methodology
Papers were selected by keyword search and two-reviewer screening.
## Conclusions
Evaluation practice remains inconsistent, which makes results hard to compare.
## References
- Lewis P. et al. Retrieval-augmented generation for knowledge-intensive NLP tasks. 2020.

# Thesis Chapter 3: Research Design
## Hypotheses
H1: Firms with independent boards disclose more climate risk. H2: The effect is larger in regulated sectors.
## Data and Methods
We use 1,450 annual reports from 2018 to 2023 and code disclosures with a fixed rubric.
## Results
Board independence predicts disclosure scores (β = 0.21, p < 0.01).
## Discussion
The result supports H1 and partly supports H2.

## Abstract
Using payroll and output data from a call centre, we estimate the productivity effect of remote work.

## Conclusion
The gains came mostly from fewer breaks and sick days.

Pedals, chains and pneumatic tyres arrived over the following decades, and with them the bicycle we know.

# The Effect of Class Size on Mathematics Attainment
## Abstract
A natural experiment from a school funding rule shows small effects of class size on attainment.
## Methods
Regression discontinuity around the 30-pupil threshold.
## Results
Smaller classes raised scores by 0.04 standard deviations.
## References
1. Angrist J, Lavy V. Using Maimonides' rule. QJE 1999.
